motivation: H2bo and H2bp retain joint accuracy but reverse complete-cost performance. Test whether one fixed token-only dispatch rule improves complete cost on a fresh declared mixture. This is a new systems policy, not a causal distance intervention.

known_outcomes: H2bp fresh uniform open-cell endpoint cohort
information_available_when_designed.H2bq: Source gates, generation, input integrity and live run-progress counters only. No H2bq final graph/outcome or aggregate cost joins read when this design is written.
information_available_when_designed.threshold_origin: 182 is the already-declared minimum Manhattan separation of H2bq opposite-quarter endpoint support. It is not selected by a sweep or by shortest labels, timings, outcome maximization or H2bq results.

cohort.wall_generator: Unchanged study.maze(180,0.8,SeedSequence([base,180,80,index])), index0..4095. Fresh walls for every input.
cohort.mixture_draw: Independent default_rng(SeedSequence([base,180,80,index,2])).integers(2):0 uniform-all-open,1 opposite-region. Probability1/2 each independently per maze; realized counts retained without quota enforcement or replacement.
cohort.endpoint_rng: default_rng(SeedSequence([base,180,80,index,1])), independent from the mixture stream and original wall generator.
cohort.uniform_component: Restore original2/3 to ordinary1; sample an ordered distinct pair uniformly without replacement from all open cells, exactly H2bp's law.
cohort.far_component: Restore old endpoints; choose uniformly among four oriented pairs NW->SE,SE->NW,NE->SW,SW->NE. Each endpoint independently uniform over open cells in its chosen45x45 corner region. Regions are NW[0,45)x[0,45),NE[0,45)x[135,180),SW[135,180)x[0,45),SE[135,180)x[135,180). Probability1/(4*Na*Nb) per eligible ordered pair, exactly H2bq's law.
cohort.eligibility: All original open cells remain traversable. Outside selected far regions are ineligible endpoints only. Empty region, invalid old endpoints or disconnected source is an integrity failure; no redraw or replacement.
cohort.rejections: None by shortest distance, Manhattan distance, difficulty, model output, mixture count or performance.
cohort.independence: Before inference, verify all4096 deterministic wall/mixture/endpoint draws and labels, token+wall uniqueness and zero token/wall overlap with every prior frozen Work manifest, including completed H2bq inputs. No fresh parameter fitting.

controls_in_table_order: BP AdamW executed prefix from the always-cascade arm, all inputs; no standalone BP service time inferred
Unchanged always-BP-first geometry-routed LP96 cascade on every input

policy.rule: Extract the unique start2 and target3 from actual input tokens inside the charged answer interval. Compute integer L1 coordinate separation D. If D<182 choose directLP96; if D>=182 execute BP then retain geometry-valid BP or route its invalid output to LP96. Boundary182 is included in BP-first.
policy.excluded_information: No mixture-component flag, generator orientation, source index, shortest distance, labels, prior failures, model votes or numerical outcome enters the dispatch rule. Original numerical acceptance remains separate.
policy.batching: Retain the original32-input batch order in all arms. Dispatcher computes shared hidden/couplings once on the complete original batch, executes BP on the ascending D>=182 subset, then runs one LP96 subset containing all D<182 inputs plus geometry-invalid BP inputs. Scatter to original identities. No cross-batch regrouping, caching answers, shared timed readiness or reusing control outputs.
policy.models: The same three immutable shared hidden models and original BP/LP parameter pairs as H2bo/H2bp/H2bq. LP96 core and native BP dynamics/caps/certificates unchanged. All model hashes bound before implementation gate.
policy.readiness: LP96 control constructs its required LP model and double copy; both complete cascade policies construct both BP and LP models/double copies afresh per complete cohort. Charge every model readiness action and its orchestration. No deferred model readiness hidden outside cost.
policy.output_equivalence_gate: For every source and measured input, dispatcher low-D outputs must equal independently executed LP96 outputs; high-D outputs must equal independently executed always-cascade outputs. Check full selected boards, numerical flags, counters, chosen model and original-factor margins, plus source subset trajectories mapped to original identities. Numerical or batch-dependent disagreement is an integrity failure, never silently repaired or discarded.

separate_primary_endpoints.absolute_dispatch_joint_success_999: Predetermined block0 dispatcher joint success across3fixed models, N4096. One-sided95% exact CP: support lower>=99.9%; falsify upper<99.9%; otherwise inconclusive.
separate_primary_endpoints.dispatch_LP96_noninferiority: Same4096maze paired events; margin-0.1percentage point. CP gain and loss marginal alpha.025 give separate one-sided95% conservative net bounds. Support lower>=-0.1pp; falsify upper<-0.1pp; otherwise inconclusive.
separate_primary_endpoints.dispatch_complete_cost_vs_LP96_saving5: For each of six fixed complete three-arm blocks, saving=1-dispatch_complete_seconds/LP96_complete_seconds. Exact rational median of ordered positions3and4; support median>=5%, else falsified. All six copies included, no timing CI.
separate_primary_endpoints.dispatch_complete_cost_vs_always_cascade: Same six blocks, saving=1-dispatch_complete_seconds/always_cascade_complete_seconds. Exact rational median positions3and4; support median>=5%, else falsified. All six copies included, no timing CI.

multiplicity: Four separate prespecified endpoints. No simultaneous95% claim; no pooled cohorts or multiplication of earlier speedups. The policy's cost advantage over both controls is claimed only if both separate fixed5% cost targets pass.
scientific_unit: 4096independent mixture draws, each jointly tested on3fixed models. Block0 is predetermined accuracy output onGPU0. Other blocks must reproduce outputs and add timing/integrity evidence only. Fixed model repeats are not independent observations.
complete_answer_cost: Charge endpoint extraction/validation, integer distance, policy dispatch, actual token transfer, shared hidden/readout, all executed BP and LP96 solver dependencies, geometry, subset gather/scatter, native/original-model numerical certificates, answer returns and complete readiness. Diagnostics/archives/audit/barrier waits are recorded outside answer cost and within wall limits. Host-wide barriers drain both workers' archive work before either times a stage and hold both workers' diagnostics until both answer stages finish. No independent CPU audit during timing; same batch membership/order and warmed runtime/filesystem-cache regime in all arms.

source_gates.fixtures: Before fresh draws, first32inputs from shards0and15 of both frozen H2bo and H2bp, all3models:384source model-inputs per actual arm. No H2bq accuracy/results are used for source selection.
source_gates.checks: All current original-state, exact routing, selected-source identity, immutable parameter, numerical-mask, after-answer diagnostic/barrier and lifecycle gates, plus new dispatcher low/high/empty-subset and exact D181/D182 tests. Original hidden/coupling parity across BP/LP models is mandatory. Full source BP and LP internal states/counters/flags/candidate traces checked after remapping. Empty full-BP or full-LP subsets must preserve actual executed work and proper receipt shapes.
source_gates.synthetic_mixture: Exhaustive tiny-grid component/orientation/endpoint support; probabilities and disjoint RNG streams; old endpoint restoration/reuse; all orientations, unequal region populations, seed and token corruption; malformed/multiple/missing endpoint rejection; exact181/182/183Manhattan boundary and permutation/scatter tests. No fresh cohort draw in gates.
source_gates.warmup: After gates and fresh input audit, fixed first32inputs of shard0 from H2bo and H2bp, all3models and all3actual arms. Warmup outside cost and within worker wall; fresh readiness again in every timed block.

diagnostics: Predeclared descriptive breakdown by mixture component, token dispatch group D<182/D>=182 and shortest bins1..64,65..128,129..256,>=257. Report every denominator, zero/empty groups, actual BP and LP counts, geometry-valid-longer BP retained, numerical/cap failures and complete per-component timing sums. No inferential subgroup claims, threshold tuning or conditional cohort omission.

proposed_budgets.budget_rationale: Six complete three-arm blocks contain2.25times as many measured full-cohort arm executions as the earlier four two-arm pairs.3000seconds/GPU is a prospective bounded allowance, compared with1500seconds/GPU earlier. Independent audit doubles its prospective wall cap for additional dispatcher-source remapping and221184timed model-pipeline copies. Caps are not extended after outcomes; all failed/incomplete attempts and denominators retained.

provenance_and_publication: Bind exact wall/endpoint/mixture generators, source and parameter files, independent auditors, fresh seed registry, all prior manifests, source gates, all attempt receipts and full per-model/per-input rows. Seal all six complete blocks before any graph/outcome join. Portable supplement contains every actual BP-to-LP geometry rescue in either cascade policy, every arm failure, every valid-longer case, and the first input per shard/model in each nonempty dispatch group (at most96fixed controls). Direct LP routing of successful low-D inputs is completely represented in scalar rows and the full Work audit; it does not alone require every positive final state in the public supplement. All selected cases retain actual all-block final states, original factors, inputs and component/dispatch metadata. Full direct/trajectory audit retained independently. Publish separate fresh results even if one or more targets fail.
support_boundary: Applies to the specified50:50iid mixture,4096fresh mazes,180x180loop80,three fixed models, Work hardware and declared warmed complete-answer boundary. No learned dispatcher, shortestness certificate, model-population claim, pure distance-causality claim, cold-start latency claim or transfer to arbitrary endpoint distributions.

diagnostic_timing_scope: Per-component timings mean operation components of full cohorts; shared mixed-batch costs are not attributed to individual inputs or mixture strata.
